name: sentinel-mcp-server
description: ⚠️ Real-time Shopee competitor price monitoring via MCP. Does NOT work standalone — requires browser extension + monitored products + MCP Key. T-0 (same-day, 3× daily) price data covering Shopee SG/MY/TH/VN/ID/PH. Push notifications: Feishu/DingTalk/Telegram.
author: haidrau

tools.name: get_monitor_list
tools.description: List all products currently being monitored

tools.name: get_price_summary
tools.description: Batch price summary across all tracked products

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Price history time-series for a specific product

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: List price drop alerts and push records

tools.name: add_monitor
tools.description: Add a new product to your monitor list

tools.name: update_monitor_status
tools.description: Pause or resume monitoring for a product

tools.name: get_crawl_health
tools.description: Check crawler engine health and statistics

sentinelToken.description: Your Sentinel MCP Key. Get it from the browser extension settings page (NOT from the website login). See: https://priceminder.online/docs/quick-start

prerequisites.description: This MCP server does NOT work standalone. Complete data pipeline: Install Extension → Follow products → Backend fetches via paid APIs → AI Can Query
steps: Browse Shopee product pages, click 'Monitor Now'
Get your MCP Key from the extension settings page
Configure your AI client with the URL and Key
prerequisites.notes: MCP Key is ONLY in the extension settings. Website login does NOT provide it. The extension only tells the system which products to watch — data collection is done by paid third-party API data services. AI can ONLY query products already added to monitoring.

can_do: View price history and trends of monitored items
Check price drop alerts and push records
Add new products to monitor (requires extension scan first)
cannot_do: Get pricing for arbitrary ASIN/product ID
Analyze competitor stores not being tracked
